OnboardingTour.AddComments.Title: Comments

OnboardingTour.AddDescription.Title: Description
OnboardingTour.AddView.Body: A view is a way of looking at the same cards: a board, a table, a calendar. A board can have as many as you like.

OnboardingTour.Columns.Body: Moving a card into a column starts the agent the card is assigned to. The agent reads the column’s name with the task, and when it is done it moves the card on itself — into the column whose name says what happened. Rename the columns to tell agents what they mean.

OnboardingTour.OpenACard.Title: Open a card
OnboardingTour.PickFolder.Body: The folder on your machine the agent works in. Add one here and every card of the board can pick it; a board with one folder fills it in by itself. A card without a folder is worked in the board’s drafts. Once the agent has started, the field stays as it is.
